records.claim: On eight fixed fresh tasks, the slate arm gained 0.1339537 macro Span-F1 and passed every registered quality metric. Five pairs were exposed; four selected slate candidates, and those four gained 0.2679074 mean Span-F1 while executed unexposed pairs gained zero Span-F1.
limitations: Only five pairs received the treatment.
This is a development canary, not confirmation or benchmark clearance.

records.claim: The preregistered canary failed guaranteed exposure: two executed treatment branches submitted before reserved finalization and one task terminated before the first-recycle fork. Treatment used 65,914 more logical tokens overall; exposed pairs used 57,403 more, dominated by one +54,833-token Rust continuation.
limitations: A missing scorer dependency caused one zero-model post-processing recovery but did not alter model outputs.
The treatment token difference includes behavioral continuation length, not only the 957–994 token slate payload.

records.next_action: Test H57: pause one shared trajectory at its first terminal candidate, then fork to exactly one control review and one slate review. Both branches receive the same review instruction and terminal-only tools; the slate payload is the sole prompt difference, every forked pair is exposed, and treatment overhead is bounded by one 1,024-token slate plus the fixed output cap.

selected_successor: H57 terminal-candidate shared fork with bounded control/slate review
